submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at a threshold of 30 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency (91.6%) among all candidate algorithms within the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV) while satisfying the allocated trigger rate, hardware deployability, and FPGA resource constraints. The requirements for using only the listed candidates, deployability in Level-1 hardware, and fitting within FPGA resource limits are all met, according to the recorded results. The recommended threshold (30 GeV) is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 is one of the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.

requirements.evidence: Recommended threshold is 30 GeV, which is within 20-60 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 at 30 GeV achieves 91.6% efficiency, higher than all other candidates at any threshold.
